programme.title: 福音電影: 天地孩兒
programme.desc: 新生兒科權威余宇熙教授,為墨爾本Monash Medical Centre新生兒科部的主管二十多年。三十年來在新生兒科不斷研究中,余教授多次突破拯救早產嬰兒的限制,將搶救期由廿八週前至廿三週,成就顯赫,為華人在西方醫學界中帶來震撼。余教授積極聯繫澳洲維多利亞省內四間新生兒科深切治療部,組織一個完善拯

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《聖經》實戰攻略
programme.desc: 節目按不同主題,包括職場、家庭、戀愛、情緒、信仰生命,邀請七位牧者從《聖經》經文結合生活例子與大家一同靈修,建立一個不離地的信徒生命。

programme.title: 麥希真牧師 末了的話 美好的工作
programme.desc: 麥希真牧師:「我是八十三歲很老很老的基督工人,『還有末了的話』(林後13:11)要告訴你們。你們都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍為留心這些十分重要『末了的話』,也許有一點助益的。」麥希真牧師將《末了的話》分成八個部分共34個題目,此部為《美好的工作》。

programme.title: 劉三論今-家和萬事興系列
programme.desc: 聖經的十條誡命,哪些跟家庭最有關係? 創世電視「信仰生活」系列 《劉三論今》,以聖經觀點來講述婚姻家庭的重要性,加進動畫、話劇、布偶及演奏的不同元素,以接地氣的輕鬆方式來教導我們婚姻家庭的經營。

programme.title: 權能時間
programme.desc: 每星期播放來自美國洛杉磯「牧人園林教會」的崇拜、啟迪心靈的詩歌、感動人心的個人見證,蕭偉柏牧師傳講神的信、望、愛的信息,鼓勵信徒活出神的教導。

programme.title: 主日講壇-宣道會北角堂
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:懇切尋求智慧的必尋見 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 王一平牧師-一言道破
programme.desc: 王一平牧師全新講道系列一言道破,以精闢的教導,讓你重新認識敬拜、恩典、事奉、平安的涵意,讓聖靈重新提醒我們,怎樣做一個真基督徒。

programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:生命沒有回程票 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 福音電影: 最危險人物
programme.desc: 「一代賊王」葉繼歡今晨於瑪麗醫院羈留病房因癌症病逝,終年55歲。 這個曾經手持AK47在街上亂槍掃射、令人聞風喪膽的賊王在被捕、越獄後再犯案。一次偷渡回港時,中槍被捕,成為半身癱瘓的囚犯。 葉繼歡於2004年歸信耶穌,2010年更親筆回信給《天使心》。 今天,小編在整理葉繼歡的書信時,發現了這一句話

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 郭文池牧師 - 給都市人的福音
programme.desc: 人無遠慮必有近憂,都市忙碌的生活,城市人的孤單焦慮隨處可見。究竟都市人在那裡可以找到福音?醫治心靈的良藥在那裡?

programme.title: 何偉強牧師-廿一世紀的屬靈人
programme.desc: 迷惘、沒有方向、疲乏,面對社會上的各種難題和困境,我們應該怎樣做,才能成為合符上帝心意的人? 何偉強牧師將會一連十三集,透過哥林多前書,與你講述處世之道。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.desc: 貂蟬的眼淚威力顛覆三國，她向黎芷珊大爆自己在三國時代有千千萬萬個「分身」！康熙遺詔上「康熙傳位十四子」與「康熙傳位于四子」之爭，令宮中謠言四起，「大鑊密探凌凌一」找到宮中知情人士大爆雍正登基的內幕！

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 西施令吳王夫差神魂顛倒，最終助越王勾踐反敗為勝，她是怎樣從重口味的鄉下妹變成美麗的天后？慈禧太后曾九道上諭要徹查「楊乃武與小白菜」案，究竟一宗婆媳糾紛如何演變成奪命血案？CID兵分三路破解冤案真相！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 農夫以故事形式介紹嘉賓JW王灝兒、梁釗峰、關楚耀與On仔（陳健安），Do姐可會收貨？曼谷的女化妝師擅長甚麼妝容？揭曉答案時還加映胡慧冲特別演出！來到「試食題」，名廚巧製「有營芝士餅」，究竟加入甚麼食材？楚耀和On仔藉「大大貼士」成功搶分，提示有多明顯？東京的監獄病院餐廳內，疑似肝臟的食品用甚麼製成？兌換環節，釗峰竟稱四個地方「各有鞦韆」；隊友JW更公開二人「親密聯繫」，引來連環笑聲！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 農夫發揮創意介紹今集嘉賓陳山聰、陳敏之，總算得到Do姐的「OK」評級。「問題專員」陳雅思拜訪「濟州石敢當」，傳說觸摸石像某部位可保健康？巴黎一部「特大自助洗衣機」原來另有玄機！Do姐說出「洗衣機沒有電子裝置」的沒用貼士，對兩隊可有啟發？台北的「一人餐廳」在餐桌上放着一款牙醫工具，卻並非放進口中，究竟得物何所用？山聰與敏之帶着相同積分進入兌換獎金環節，但最終出現天堂與地獄的結果！

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: Bettany繼續她的旅程,走訪烏茲別克、喬治亞、亞塞拜然、希臘、土耳其和保加利亞等地探索偏遠的社區,為觀眾帶來新的考古發掘以及意想不到的故事。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 由於還沒獲得星夢電子蛋，德薇與瑠羽在樂園四出搜尋，希望找到被丟棄的星夢電子蛋，卻遇上被露露娜追趕的Bug Bug CHU，還跟他成為了好友。露露娜稱Bug Bug CHU相當危險，德薇與瑠羽卻不以為然，一場追逐戰因而展開。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2粵普
喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2粵普
多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄頭頭碰著黑，多啦A夢借他「轉運針」，可以令運氣恢復平衡。爸爸借了「令人討厭錢的糖」，大雄借了「令人想派錢的糖」，千方百計想互相餵食。胖虎搶走了「元旦日出套裝」，結果自討苦吃。

programme.title: LET'S CAMP! 露營少女粵日
programme.desc: 野外同好會需要大量劈柴，撫子正好借機會聽千明與葵覆述她們和惠那去山梨北露營發生的種種。前往營地之前，三人先在水垣湖尋找隱世美食，卻因此錯過巴士，為了泡溫泉，她們不惜徒步翻山越嶺。

programme.title: 嫁到這世界邊端粵
programme.desc: Judy、Dass帶陳貝兒參觀其位於曼谷市中心的安樂窩，貝兒從蝸居察覺到女方是話事人，男方則甘於被管，皆因他們深信「緣份」。身為佛教徒的貝兒，又怎樣看這二字？Judy認定遇到Dass是過世姐姐在天上安排，還因他改變急躁性格。兩口子坦言彼此是「愛情抽獎」的幸運兒，為何Dass認定Judy抽中了大獎？Judy嫁到泰國沒有受到歧視，反而Dass不停被同鄉歧視，Judy看不過眼要為丈夫說幾句！

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 砂煲煲仔飯充滿傳統風味，看過鼎爺傳授新砂煲的保養方法，再由俊彥炮製「窩蛋免治牛肉煲仔飯」。俊彥採用上盛免治和牛、牛肩胛肉製作肉餅，配上恰到好處的流心蛋，味道與口感令人期待！飯焦夠香口，看三姐運用普洱茶、花生等製作新派飯焦。煒哥則帶來「海鮮肉餅煲仔飯」，除用上瑤柱、蝦乾等惹味海味，亦自製金銀蒜醬襯托海蝦，並以帶子夾金華火腿，「大堆頭」用料令煲仔飯陣容鼎盛，但鼎爺卻認為做法浪費了某種食材的鮮味？

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 過年之前，一於炮製兩道「年年有魚」應節佳餚！煒哥呈獻「魚羊鮮」，將桂花魚起肉，以魚骨連同鯽魚、羊頸骨、羊腩肉等煮湯，雙飛魚肉用湯焯熟，保留鮮甜。煒哥以薑、蔥、蒜等製作醬汁，配魚肉同吃加倍鮮味。俊彥揀選東星班炮製「意式瘋狂水煮魚」，以魚骨、月桂葉、紅蘿蔔等煲湯，加入沙白蜆熬出的鮮甜湯汁，配上番茄碎及番茄汁；將表皮煎至金黃的魚肉下湯中浸熟，份外嫩滑。兩道鮮美菜式令眾人吃不停！評分時間，有人竟然投兩票？

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: Gigi姐為大家示範做五香雞，而當中最重要的訣竅就是用雞的重量去衡量所需要的五香粉和粗鹽分量。而Gigi姐這次選用了嘉美雞，因為她喜歡它有獨特的質感和雞香味。在醃製時，她還出動秘密用具，究竟會是什麼？

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 李佳芯經常帶觀眾「捐窿捐罅」搜羅各區美食情報，對於「搵食」極具心得。然而，她在烹調甜品方面又是否同樣到家？古嘉俊邀請她合作炮製一款「抹茶朱古力千層蛋糕」，口味「層」出不窮，製作過程更是趣味十足。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 御富良院有感風神丸力量不足，打算鍛鍊他，但對方老是不出現，此時他們遇到肌肉微笑健兒，後者指出御富良院變強即風神丸變強，御富良院茅塞頓開，於是努力做健兒教的體操，誰知結果卻弄巧反拙。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 有家長為小孩子報讀很多興趣班，以發掘孩子潛能，主持表示原來AI也可幫忙？「My Little Show」，四位舞者前來表演森巴舞、十歲歌者演唱<Over The Rainbow，從她們表演時展現的投入度，都可看出大家對跳舞和唱歌的興趣與熱愛吧！小朋友盼望長大，而成年人總嚮往童年，結他導師帶來八十年代兒童節目《430穿梭機》的主題曲，頌唱<童年時光。此外，導師亦帶來關於考獲樂器演奏級的資訊。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 因為突然有客人來訪，令媽媽無法帶小丸子去百貨公司參加某個活動。不甘心的小丸子，唯有提議姐姐一起出外遊玩。野口同學提及一本恐怖漫畫。小丸子因好奇而借了回家。由於不敢獨自看，於是邀請爺爺一起。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 近年市民對生活用品的消費越趨審慎，超市市道也在持續調整，讓主打環球直採的「平價超市」廣受消費者青睞，並且在各區急速冒起。這類超市如何在香港的零售實體市場，站穩陣腳？不少銀行及保安公司都有提供保險箱租賃服務，市場需求有多大？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 由食環署和屋宇署組成的聯合辦事處，俗稱滲水辦，每年平均接獲逾四萬宗滲水個案，大部分滲水源頭來自上層單位，政府於今年七月中，亦推行調查私樓滲水的新程序，期望縮短調查時間。有居住在舊唐樓、受滲水困擾的業主放棄執修，冀等待重建處理問題；有新收樓的業主面對滲水問題卻求助無援；有年過七旬的雙老長者及家中有孕婦的家庭，也正面對天花剝落等滲水危機，居民以為能夠得到一個安樂窩，受滲水困擾可以如何處理？

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 昨(5)日，義工發現有人利用假貼紙、假證明等在旺角「賣假旗」，真賣旗團體亦發聲明指遭冒充。事主求購卡牌相約當面交收，並以「轉數快」轉帳。但對方稱記錄的手機號碼與姓名資料不符，事主以為「過錯數」下，再次轉帳，其後始知墮入新型騙局，共捐失近四萬元！觀眾疑因光顧內地採耳服務致發炎，持醫學證明欲追討，反被店方指詐騙？肥媽宴請「中4」眾評審拍檔、選手聚餐，大玩「唱K接龍」；另帶來《女神配對計劃2》記招花絮。

programme.title: 中信銀行(國際)Motion$呈獻：試真D唷粵
programme.desc: 江美儀繼續帶隊，這趟前赴台灣高雄「試真D唷」。自稱三十年歷史的燒肉老店，網上充斥「有甲甴」負評。美儀姐引領吳業坤、GM曾展望探店，點餐時已發現「小強兄弟」，「試真D」後卻發聲平反。坐在公園試吃平價巨型飯糰，坤哥、GM立即回店加購，究竟有多好吃？為歡迎張振朗加入，美儀姐帶他和坤哥到旗津食海鮮。團隊在觀光區發掘到良心店家，但也直擊到疑似專門「劏旅客」的食肆。要留意三人充滿腥味的真實食評，趕緊「避雷」！

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：女神配對計劃2粵PG
programme.desc: 優質男士集結海選，希望通過主持Bob、嘉賓江美儀等考驗，入圍追求女神，首集來個花生搶先看！爆肌健身教練「公主抱」Bob做深蹲，驚變男男配對？街頭健身運動員展示「特別」動作，前女神關嘉敏、梁敏巧睇到嘩嘩聲。投行型男則以湯馬斯全旋，技驚四座！某男士隔空向心儀多年的女神真誠告白、有演員目標明確望續前緣，外向小鮮肉卻直言理想對象是樂小姐？首季表現「突出」的面試者回歸，水準依舊；海選還出現花生團熟悉的面孔？

programme.title: 一周星星粵PG
programme.desc: 緣分促成錢嘉樂、湯盈盈走在一起，盈盈2005年憑扮演醜角突圍而出，接受《東張》訪問時竟向路過的錢嘉樂問過一句「會唔會同我拍拖」？經典劇《封神榜》中，兩人是敵對關係，盈盈卻對拍攝已零記憶，只記得嘉樂在火車站的一次「身手展示」……好姊妹佘詩曼、姚樂怡、梁靖琪紛紛透過片段，盛讚「貪玩盈盈」結婚、生育後的改變；洪天明、洪金寶則大讚嘉樂於洪家班的本領。盈盈指一直期待嘉樂說出某「三個字」，能藉這次訪問如願嗎？

programme.title: Dear Leslie 70粵
programme.desc: 「哥哥」張國榮於《十大勁歌金曲頒獎典禮》成就非凡，不僅連續六年奪金曲獎，更曾榮獲「最受歡迎男歌星」和「金曲金獎」。除了重溫他的得獎時刻，樂迷亦可再次細聽<當年情、<有誰共鳴等「哥歌」，還有其傾注情感的<我。客串《香港'86》之餘，哥哥在《儂本多情》、《武林世家》的演出亦讓大眾着迷。哥哥於TVB的音樂特輯、MV片段，以及綜藝節目中的精彩表演亦會出土。他當年雌雄同體的前衛舞台，更是令人印象深刻。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 不嗜甜食的張與辰對灣仔一間「人氣」糖水店情有獨鍾，他與行仔品嚐芒果雙皮奶，更向老闆偷師炮製嫩滑燉奶的秘訣。黃嘉雯駕車載胡美貽到淺水灣開餐，享用炸魚塔可、手工西班牙油條配海鹽焦糖醬等輕食，享受悠閒時光。食評家Agnes推介主打避風塘風味的名人愛店，古法避風塘炒蟹及燒鴨湯河均為必吃招牌菜，滋味正宗。黃嘉雯再帶伍倩彤到錦田一間隱世餐廳，細味當歸豬膶豬骨湯米粉及煎肉餅飯等家常滋味，食材新鮮，令人回味無窮。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
飛虎3壯志英雄#2粵PG
programme.desc: 要放走很可能跟化武交易有密切關係的Pat先生，何家寶很不甘心。不斷努力找證據，但上級還是命她護送Pat先生去機場回國。途中遇到一幫匪徒企圖劫走Pat先生，與飛虎隊展開激烈駁火，匪徒事敗逃走。

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: Bettany繼續她的旅程,走訪烏茲別克、喬治亞、亞塞拜然、希臘、土耳其和保加利亞等地探索偏遠的社區,為觀眾帶來新的考古發掘以及意想不到的故事。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#179粵
programme.desc: 自從溢跟母親到美國後，義每晚都要人陪他與溢視象會議。義被公司勒令放假，到按摩椅專門店消磨時間，但竟讓他發現，花亦被勒令放假，令義驚覺二人皆沒有知心友。朋命義為家中進行維修，義向花求救，花義無反顧答應。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#24粵普
programme.desc: 郭靖和黃蓉在白鵰的幫助下離開鐵掌山，為躲避追捕，又走進了瘴氣林。在瑛姑的指引下，二人找到段皇爺替黃蓉療傷，段皇爺服下黃蓉所贈的九花玉露丸以便恢復元氣，卻不料中毒；得知下毒的是瑛姑，便提及二人昔日恩怨…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 退休Chill級歎世界粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 今集造訪凍肉海產公司搜購超平凍肉，不用五元就買到一大隻鴨髀，炮製「鴨腿湯飯」至抵吃。「牛油、青口、天使麵」這個組合落入肥媽手上，24元就煮得好美味。還有肥媽推介、味道豐富的「醬燒巴西豬仔骨配焗薯」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 長期鼻塞未必單純由感冒或鼻敏感引起，可能與鼻中隔彎曲有關？先天或後天因素都有機會引致此結構問題，耳鼻喉科醫生帶來治療資訊，還提醒長期依賴通鼻塞藥物，恐會陷入惡性循環。戲劇大師毛俊輝繼續細談在美國的演出經歷，開心獲業內知名導演賞識。回港發展後，他亦難忘抱病與黃霑、顧嘉煇攜手打造勵志音樂劇。此外，他感激太太胡美儀多年來不離不棄，也談及透過慈善基金，培育戲劇新一代。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「人參魚湯」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 嘉賓王敏奕自懂得談戀愛起迷上下廚，還視之為傳遞愛的好方法。她近來喜歡鑽研素食，帶來一道既簡單又惹味的「韓式燒素牛肉」。杏鮑菇可變奏出不同滋味，諾懿大花心思，為美女獻上「杏鮑菇玫瑰」。揀選扇貝有何要訣？黑松露、金銀蒜看似味道不搭，兩者一同加入扇貝蒸煮，卻換來意想不到的驚喜！敏奕自製卡邦尼汁，奉上「蘑菇貓耳貝殼粉」；她又建議善用煮意粉水，可以有多種用途。另外，敏之亦會一展刀功，將士多啤梨變成美艷花朵。

programme.title: 天梯#10粵
programme.desc: 濟民要代苗天還債，更指賀正堂已無可救藥，無必要害苗天。濟民使計避開苗天，不讓他有請辭的機會。苗天未開口請辭，濟民已對苗天破口大罵，更打了他一拳，苗天承諾只幫賀正堂一年，最後濟民高聲嚷出要解僱苗天。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 聽到同學們說起善解人意的爸爸，再回家目睹自己爸爸宏志醉醺醺的樣子，令小丸子產生了比較心理，對爸爸滿肚牢騷。小丸子更嘗試透過改變稱謂，希望讓宏志變成理想中的好爸爸，但宏志卻依然故我……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 非撞式欖球的主要特點在於禁止猛烈衝撞與擒抱，防守方只需以手輕觸進攻球員，對方就必須停下。非撞式欖球學校兩位代表到來「Kids’ Notes」，介紹這項運動的規則與玩法。由於非撞式欖球的身體接觸較少，適合男女一同參與；同來的女學員亦分享非撞式欖球的獨特吸引力。兩位代表淺談非撞式欖球的發展前景，更指出小朋友如參與這運動，不僅可鍛練體能，也能培養良好的堅毅精神與紀律。本集還有AI生成動畫《塞翁失馬》。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄用「重量燈」改變事物重量，先替媽媽解決體重煩惱，其後加重自己，成功把胖虎撞飛。大雄想借「傳染癦痣」轉移性格避過胖虎責罰，誰知在陰差陽錯下，令胖虎變得像野貓一般獸性大發。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 退休Chill級歎世界粵
programme.desc: 位處北都的洪水橋，樓價一直相對低水，政府早前於區內以片區形式賣地，能否刺激樓價？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#21粵
programme.desc: 萬里需找舞伴出席為客人籌辦的慈善舞會，原屬意與文謙同行，卻遭他婉拒，遂考慮找安多勳作伴。朱圓圓卻大潑冷水，認為二人並不合襯，難有長遠發展。她更遞上一張卡片，提出可讓安多勳「彌補不足」的建議。面對舞伴人選，萬里始終猶豫不決。此時，安多勳一個奇異舉動，竟勾起萬里一段痛苦往事，並引發連串風波……安多勳意外得知萬里打算邀請他出席舞會，更偶然發現那張卡片，明白萬里的顧慮，遂決意成為「襯得起」她的舞伴……

programme.title: 死有對証#1粵PG
programme.desc: 清晨時分，流浪漢於垃圾站內發現疑似人肉屍塊。新任女法醫程芷昕第一天上班就奉命到場，搜索其餘的人體組織。芷昕自小患有強迫症，為人心直口快，在搜索過程中與重案組警員高俊結下不解之緣。芷昕想參與檢驗骸骨，卻被上司林琛投閒置散。法醫方文琪請客歡迎芷昕加入殮房團隊，從芷昕推薦的「佳權飯店」叫來外賣；林琛竟發現與案件有關的線索。同時，高俊也着手調查，線索皆指向佳權……芷昕閨密單佩嘉因吃過佳權的飯菜，大感不安。

programme.title: 百花殺#3粵普PG
programme.desc: 各皇子為取得西北軍權而想娶汐和，華雍便出手打擊。汐和得悉《胭脂錄》的幕後主使是康王，便誘使康王府的羅側妃頂證他。康王被捉拿後，對華雍透露當日餵他吃酪櫻桃的人就是下毒之人，而此人正是父皇，華雍不願相信…

programme.title: 玄戰粵PG
programme.desc: 自古以來，參透未來、扭轉乾坤的玄妙之術總是令人神往。然而，在流派百家爭鳴的當前，真正洞悉天機的能人，到底身在何方？注入直播元素的新節目《玄戰》，會掀開不一樣的戰幕。節目組廣邀潛藏民間的玄學高手化身「黑先知」，眾人務必通過重重嚴苛關卡，爭奪晉級資格。海選中表現最好五人獲賦以「白先知」身分，並與突圍而出的黑先知開展對壘。這是一場賭上名譽與實力的玄學之戰，究竟誰人可破譯天機、洞悉玄奧，成為「一代先知」？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 退休Chill級歎世界粵
澳娛綜合呈獻：十月初五的月光#1粵PG
programme.desc: 歌女朱莎嬌年青時裙下之臣無數，卻不為所動。嬌妹莎華為人記仇，嫁得賭業鉅子萬世光，對舊情敵文貴芳仍懷恨在心。貴芳遭拋棄，莎華心涼。貴芳欲攜子文初尋死，不果，一走了之，遺下因受驚過度變成啞巴的文初由莎嬌撫養。莎嬌及後邂逅大學生祝展輝，為他誕下一女君好。展輝赴英升學，遺下母女。記者司徒禮信籌備澳門專輯，到賭場偷拍卻與君好發生誤會。文初得悉賭場中人對禮信不利，莎嬌、君好與禮信在一起，立即趕至救回眾人。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#179粵
programme.desc: 自從溢跟母親到美國後，義每晚都要人陪他與溢視象會議。義被公司勒令放假，到按摩椅專門店消磨時間，但竟讓他發現，花亦被勒令放假，令義驚覺二人皆沒有知心友。朋命義為家中進行維修，義向花求救，花義無反顧答應。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#24粵普
programme.desc: 郭靖和黃蓉在白鵰的幫助下離開鐵掌山，為躲避追捕，又走進了瘴氣林。在瑛姑的指引下，二人找到段皇爺替黃蓉療傷，段皇爺服下黃蓉所贈的九花玉露丸以便恢復元氣，卻不料中毒；得知下毒的是瑛姑，便提及二人昔日恩怨…

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#180粵
programme.desc: 溢覺花的電腦需更換零件，便在花的鐵盒中取出兩張五百元紙幣。但這兩張紙幣是當日花從義身上搶來的，獲花視為至寶。義感冒，花對義呵顧備至，溢從花的電腦中，找到一封「寄不出的情信」，揭發花瘋狂地暗戀著義。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#25粵普PG
programme.desc: 瑛姑本想殺一燈，裘千仞來到，瑛姑認出他是殺她孩兒真兇，兩人交手，郭靖黃蓉出手相助。一燈大師翻譯《九陰真經》梵文總綱，表示依此修練，武功很快會復原。江南六怪想解除全真教對黃藥師的誤會，黃藥師卻避而不見。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽有云「識食一定係食細魚」，六號立即學習用梭羅魚煲湯。肥媽常教大家用電飯煲煮雞，「水晶雞」又有甚麼來頭？愈來愈少家庭會用慈菇做菜，肥媽決定示範利用南乳汁、五花腩加慈菇做菜；她又教煮「韓國泡菜煎餅」。

programme.title: 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 來自選秀節目《魔音女團》的莊子璇、喬美莎、倪樂琳、宋宛穎、倪嘉雯、盧映彤等「星級」藝員參演的微短劇。故事描述Hilary(莊子璇)為了追尋唱跳夢，參加「超級新星」選拔；某天，她於偶然下發現「魔幻百變床褥」的神奇效果，毅然有所決定……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 運動有益，但部份重複的動作，或會造成慢性的「運動創傷」。骨科醫生詳析有關肩部的創傷，如何分辨創傷與肌肉痠勞？除了主要採用的保守治療資訊，醫生亦細說急性肩部創傷的「PRICE」處理原則。李蕙敏的慘情歌足以「一刀插入人心」，相隔十幾年再出新歌，卻是一首思念離世父親的親情歌，緣何有這構思？她接觸過不同工種，也曾開時裝店，不斷自我增值；對於新時代女性，有甚麼看法？「睇餸食飯」，三姐示範「涼瓜子薑牛脆麵」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 白鱔是秋冬當造食材，諾懿先傳授簡單的去潺方法，並製作彈牙可口的「日式炭燒白鱔」。不需講究刀功，亦可將青葡萄、啤梨變成得意箭豬，留意敏之示範。嘉賓糖妹喜歡挑戰花功夫的菜式，她到來炮製「糖妹釀蟹蓋」，盡顯廚藝心思！下廚期間，她提到「鮑魚有眼」的說法，令主持們大感驚訝……原條牛柳肉質嫩滑，糖妹用多款香料與紅酒煮成醬汁，將牛柳燜煮至軟腍入味，諾懿從旁協助卻笑言被當作「鑊鏟」？諾懿另會奉上「火焰煙燻牛柳」。

programme.title: 天梯#11粵
programme.desc: 新月宣布新任大查櫃乃苗天，苗天告知全叔的記錄簿，新月為可重新聯絡客戶而高興。苗天建議鄭嬌回鄉拜祭妻子，鄭嬌往找愛娣卻沒有人應門；達嫂表示愛娣已幾天沒踏出家門，鄭嬌用木梯爬進愛娣屋內，發現愛娣躺在床上。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子看見百惠穿大紅色晚裝很漂亮，於是自己也打扮到全身紅色，更遇上同樣一身火紅的青年音樂人。藤木發現藍色能代表自己，更是很好的顏色，於是打扮到一身藍色，卻意外吸引到一名女生的目光。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: Tiffany姐姐一人引領薯片隊、曲奇隊小兵進入零食廠，與蚌蚌公主打招呼後，便隨即開展「廠長話」遊戲。某位女隊員稍一鬆懈就出現失誤，拍檔疑受影響亦跟着做錯指令，最終一起遭淘汰。運送雪糕球任務，四位小兵看來都非常大膽，雙方皆順利做出共廿個或以上的佳績，實力旗鼓相當！輪到堆疊漢堡包食材的比拼，兩隊於第一回合的表現不相伯仲。第二回合，薯片兵團縱有點亂了陣腳，卻可快速反省，並於最後一輪作出改善，值得一讚。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 果Jam叔叔一行人，為了觀看演奏會而前往Do- Re-Mi-Fa島。在途中，細菌人因為討厭音樂而阻撓一行人前進。細菌人襲擊大碗飯三人組失敗了。之後碰巧發現濃湯嬸嬸正製作濃湯，便企圖偷吃。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 胃癌是起源於胃黏膜上皮的惡性腫瘤，初期症狀常與胃炎或胃潰瘍相似而不易察覺。除了做手術切除受影響的胃部，部分亦要接受吊針化療，而且要配合口服化療藥。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 富途證券特約:富途講美股粵 及 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#22粵
programme.desc: 戴志昌的公司推出新產品，萬里欲與楊帆爭奪此宣傳項目。志昌有意為產品物色靚聲代言人，偶然聽到嘉冰的歌聲後大為欣賞，更積極接近她。朱圓圓懷疑志昌另有企圖，萬里起初不以為然，其後卻漸覺不妥。嘉冰得知志昌是萬里的重要客戶後，不顧萬里勸阻，答應與他飯聚。楊帆質疑萬里為爭取項目而利用嘉冰，並指志昌過往與代言人飯聚後往往另有安排。萬里大感不安，急忙聯絡嘉冰，惟她已到埗，更表示會盡力協助萬里爭取這個項目……

programme.title: 死有對証#2粵PG
programme.desc: 高俊等重案組警員到「佳權飯店」展開調查，確認店內為案發現場，遇害者正是老闆娘。老闆娘的姪女阮碧鳳、姪兒阮濤在佳權工作，同稱對姑丈、姑母失蹤不知情。港聞記者詹柏宇窮追不捨地追訪阮氏姊弟，芷昕撞見後上前解圍，並邀請二人到家中作客。芷昕察覺碧鳳手上有紅疹，欲關心她，兩姊弟卻匆匆離開。重案組接獲線報，在廢屋中發現佳權老闆的遺體及老闆娘原先下落不明的頭顱，老闆疑似畏罪輕生。林琛解剖屍體後，有重大發現……

programme.title: 百花殺#4粵普PG
programme.desc: 華雍特意引汐和看花燈，汐和看穿疏林是女子，教她跟晉百做朋友令其他女子不敢靠近；有朝臣女兒侮辱西北，瀠繞想害汐和落水，汐和反擊…華雍邀汐和觀賞蔓星苔發現彼此投契，長贏帶安西防禦圖殘角拜訪汐和，汐和拒見…

programme.title: 玄戰粵PG
programme.desc: 自古以來，參透未來、扭轉乾坤的玄妙之術總是令人神往。然而，在流派百家爭鳴的當前，真正洞悉天機的能人，到底身在何方？注入直播元素的新節目《玄戰》，會掀開不一樣的戰幕。節目組廣邀潛藏民間的玄學高手化身「黑先知」，眾人務必通過重重嚴苛關卡，爭奪晉級資格。海選中表現最好五人獲賦以「白先知」身分，並與突圍而出的黑先知開展對壘。這是一場賭上名譽與實力的玄學之戰，究竟誰人可破譯天機、洞悉玄奧，成為「一代先知」？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
澳娛綜合呈獻：十月初五的月光#2粵PG
programme.desc: 文初為救眾人受傷送院，禮信內疚。文初好友金勝到賭場找晦氣，被世光、莎華所逐。世光長子沛堅與君好好友汪海琳相戀，因門戶不登對不為莎華所接受。金勝雖風流，獨荷官江依文對他死心塌地。世光自知其手下令文初受傷，著莎華找莎嬌擺平。莎華心知莎嬌不會接受自己的金錢，簽下香油祈求莎嬌一家平安作補償。沛堅為報答文初不供出誰放炸彈，介紹文初到芬蘭浴室工作。莎嬌無意中知道文初到浴室工作，震怒不已。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 運動有益，但部份重複的動作，或會造成慢性的「運動創傷」。骨科醫生詳析有關肩部的創傷，如何分辨創傷與肌肉痠勞？除了主要採用的保守治療資訊，醫生亦細說急性肩部創傷的「PRICE」處理原則。李蕙敏的慘情歌足以「一刀插入人心」，相隔十幾年再出新歌，卻是一首思念離世父親的親情歌，緣何有這構思？她接觸過不同工種，也曾開時裝店，不斷自我增值；對於新時代女性，有甚麼看法？「睇餸食飯」，三姐示範「涼瓜子薑牛脆麵」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 白鱔是秋冬當造食材，諾懿先傳授簡單的去潺方法，並製作彈牙可口的「日式炭燒白鱔」。不需講究刀功，亦可將青葡萄、啤梨變成得意箭豬，留意敏之示範。嘉賓糖妹喜歡挑戰花功夫的菜式，她到來炮製「糖妹釀蟹蓋」，盡顯廚藝心思！下廚期間，她提到「鮑魚有眼」的說法，令主持們大感驚訝……原條牛柳肉質嫩滑，糖妹用多款香料與紅酒煮成醬汁，將牛柳燜煮至軟腍入味，諾懿從旁協助卻笑言被當作「鑊鏟」？諾懿另會奉上「火焰煙燻牛柳」。

programme.title: 天梯#11粵
programme.desc: 新月宣布新任大查櫃乃苗天，苗天告知全叔的記錄簿，新月為可重新聯絡客戶而高興。苗天建議鄭嬌回鄉拜祭妻子，鄭嬌往找愛娣卻沒有人應門；達嫂表示愛娣已幾天沒踏出家門，鄭嬌用木梯爬進愛娣屋內，發現愛娣躺在床上。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#180粵
programme.desc: 溢覺花的電腦需更換零件，便在花的鐵盒中取出兩張五百元紙幣。但這兩張紙幣是當日花從義身上搶來的，獲花視為至寶。義感冒，花對義呵顧備至，溢從花的電腦中，找到一封「寄不出的情信」，揭發花瘋狂地暗戀著義。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#25粵普PG
programme.desc: 瑛姑本想殺一燈，裘千仞來到，瑛姑認出他是殺她孩兒真兇，兩人交手，郭靖黃蓉出手相助。一燈大師翻譯《九陰真經》梵文總綱，表示依此修練，武功很快會復原。江南六怪想解除全真教對黃藥師的誤會，黃藥師卻避而不見。

programme.title: 我是小廚神-新加坡篇粵普
programme.desc: 來到總決賽，主題是「自選菜單」，Tebo、Leonika要在三小時內製作頭盤、主菜和甜品，爭奪冠軍寶座。Leonika刻意加入廣東元素，以中藥材蒸紅斑魚帶出「家」的味道，令一眾香港主持及評判一解鄉愁！神奇小子Tebo煎三文魚恰到好處，全宇宙最「脆」的蘋果酥還成功俘虜人心！評判團張倩敏、楊國基、黃淑儀如何抉擇？

programme.title: CI ALK 國際直球對決(重)

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.desc: Oh no, Jeremy ran out of gas! Troy selects the most perfect truck to refuel him: Tyson the Tanker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Francis the Forklift helps at the construction site
programme.desc: Edgar made a mess at the construction site! Troy selects the best truck to help with the clean-up: Francis the Forklift!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyler the Tyke steals candy
programme.desc: Tyler stole some candy from Baby Francis! Troy selects the bravest, fastest car to stop him: Matt the Police Car!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Chuck the Cherry Picker saves the day!
programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.desc: After surviving a car crash when running away from home, Tia finds herself having nowhere to go. Seeking out the family of the crash victim, she moves in with them and threatens to upend the family’s delicate balance.

programme.title: Mediterranea
programme.desc: Two men make the dangerous journey from Africa to Italy for a better life but then face hostility and violence in this shocking look at the life-and-death struggle of refugees.

programme.title: Roise & Frank
programme.desc: Recently widowed Róise is struggling with her grief following her husband's passing. However, when a stray dog starts to follow her around, she starts to believe that it might be the reincarnation of her husband.

programme.title: The Deep
programme.desc: March 1984, a few miles off the south coast of Iceland, a fishing boat sank with all its men. One of the crew members miraculously survived. After six hours in the ocean, the exhausted man is washed ashore, only to find himself on a deadly lava field.

programme.title: Helen Dorn: Breathless
programme.desc: In an illegal arms case, three men, including two policemen, are dead. Mattheisen reveals a radical right-wing conspiracy, and suspects a mole. However, he is shot dead with Inspector Dorn’s weapon, while Dorn is found at the crime scene with no memory.

programme.title: On The Fringe
programme.desc: The countdown of three characters – lawyer-activist Rafa, cashier Azucena and grandmother Teodora - with three interwoven stories who try to stay afloat and survive 24 key hours that may forever change the course of their lives.

programme.title: Passenger 23
programme.desc: Martin, a police psychologist who lost his wife and his son during a vacation, receives a call that brings new clues about the disappearance of his family and returns to the same cruise ship to discover the truth.

programme.title: Vera Dreams of the Sea
programme.desc: Vera, a devoted wife, mother, and grandmother, has her serene life turned upside down by her husband's sudden suicide. As greedy relatives and an underworld scheme threaten their family’s home, she must confront danger and take control of her own fate.

programme.title: Helen Dorn: The Seeds Of Violence
programme.desc: At the Hamburg DOM festival, Helen Dorn and forensic scientist Weyer witness a paramedic's brutal assault. When a high-society boy is later found dead, unravelling a dark secret linking the two cases.

programme.title: Jeera Goli
programme.desc: The pursuit of a 4-year-old innocent Dev, wanting to play with his grandfather, but isn't allowed to by his parents as unknown to him, his grandfather is in a coma.

programme.title: Shadow of Fire
programme.desc: In the ashes of war, three strangers - a woman forced to sell her body, a starving orphan, and a broken soldier - find fragile solace together. Shadow Of Fire is a raw, haunting tale of loss, survival, and the fleeting warmth of human connection.

programme.title: Broll: Buried Alive
programme.desc: Gravedigger Max Broll and retired soccer star Baroni team up to find Max’s stepmother Tilda, the local police commissioner, who has been abducted and buried alive in the woods. The clock is ticking – Tilda won`t survive more than 48 hours underground.

programme.title: The Inland Road

programme.title: Jeanny: The Fifth Girl
programme.desc: In a picturesque tiny town near Vienna, young girls have been vanishing without a trace for years. Jeanny has just fallen in love with a mysterious man. But when she notices signs of a dark side in him, she becomes suspicious. Will she be the next victim?

programme.title: The Reports on Sarah and Saleem
programme.desc: The illicit affair of a married Palestinian man and a married Israeli woman in Jerusalem takes a dangerous political dimension when they are spotted in the wrong place at the wrong time leaving them to deal with more than their broken marriages.

programme.title: Three Quarter Moon
programme.desc: Hartmut, a taxi-driver, is left in a bitter slump when his wife leaves him. That is, until he gets six-year-old Hayat and her mother in his taxi. In a serendipitous turn of events, Hayat is left under his care and she helps him learn to enjoy life again.

programme.desc: Vera, a devoted wife, mother, and grandmother, has her serene life turned upside down by her husband's sudden suicide. As greedy relatives and an underworld scheme threaten their family’s home, she must confront danger and take control of her own fate.

programme.title: Helen Dorn: The Seeds Of Violence
programme.desc: At the Hamburg DOM festival, Helen Dorn and forensic scientist Weyer witness a paramedic's brutal assault. When a high-society boy is later found dead, unravelling a dark secret linking the two cases.

programme.title: Cloves &amp; Carnations
programme.desc: In snowy and desolate South Eastern Anatolian, Musa carries the corpse of his deceased wife to their homeland with his granddaughter. As they get closer to a country at war, their run-in with the police separates them in different directions.

programme.title: Jeanny: The Fifth Girl
programme.desc: In a picturesque tiny town near Vienna, young girls have been vanishing without a trace for years. Jeanny has just fallen in love with a mysterious man. But when she notices signs of a dark side in him, she becomes suspicious. Will she be the next victim?

programme.title: Metal Heart
programme.desc: Fraternal twin sisters Emma and Chantal are worlds apart. When their parents go away for the summer, their simmering sibling rivalry threatens to boil over, especially when the mysterious boy next door moves back in.

programme.title: Broll: Buried Alive
programme.desc: Gravedigger Max Broll and retired soccer star Baroni team up to find Max’s stepmother Tilda, the local police commissioner, who has been abducted and buried alive in the woods. The clock is ticking – Tilda won`t survive more than 48 hours underground.

programme.title: Helen Dorn: The Last Resort
programme.desc: Haunted by a colleague's suicide and grappling with guilt, Helen Dorn confronts the unspoken accusations of her fellow officers. At the same time, she is assigned to solve a medical student's murder, where she soon uncovers their double life.

programme.title: The Reports on Sarah and Saleem
programme.desc: The illicit affair of a married Palestinian man and a married Israeli woman in Jerusalem takes a dangerous political dimension when they are spotted in the wrong place at the wrong time leaving them to deal with more than their broken marriages.

programme.title: The Grump: In Search Of An Escort
programme.desc: The Grump, a stubborn old Finnish farmer, goes on a quest to find a replacement for his beloved second-hand car. He goes to Germany to do so, but ends up settling accounts with his past.

programme.title: Three Quarter Moon
programme.desc: Hartmut, a taxi-driver, is left in a bitter slump when his wife leaves him. That is, until he gets six-year-old Hayat and her mother in his taxi. In a serendipitous turn of events, Hayat is left under his care and she helps him learn to enjoy life again.

programme.title: The Last Harvest
programme.desc: Traumatized policeman Ben delves into his own past to investigate a cold case obscured by a web of guilt, lies and deception. In the process, Marion, a doctor, helps him come to terms with himself and his past.

programme.title: Virgin Mountain
programme.desc: Fusi is in his forties and yet to find courage to enter the adult world. He sleepwalks through everyday life, where routine is key. Unexpected events force him to make drastic decisions.

programme.title: The Odd-Job Men
programme.desc: A week in the life of Moha, Valero and Pep - workers in a small plumbing and electricity company in the outskirts of Barcelona, Spain. Moha is on a one-week trial period and is set to replace Pep, but Valero doesn't think he has what it takes.

programme.title: Victim
programme.desc: Ukrainian immigrant Irina lives with her son Igor in a small Czech border town. When she discovers that Igor has been assaulted by three Romas her whole world comes crashing down. As times goes on, Irina begins to spot inconsistencies in his story.

programme.title: Domingo
programme.desc: After his divorce, 55-year-old Domingo embarks on a belated journey to fulfil his lifelong dream – to become a sports commentator. Though he aspires to join the local TV station, his commentaries are unknowingly leaving an impact on his community.

programme.title: The Last Harvest
programme.desc: Traumatized policeman Ben delves into his own past to investigate a cold case obscured by a web of guilt, lies and deception. In the process, Marion, a doctor, helps him come to terms with himself and his past.

programme.title: Helen Dorn: The Red Cloth
programme.desc: A fatal arson incident draws Helen Dorn into a far-left extremist community, who has targeted wealthy real estate agent Ralph Wagner. While they deny any involvement in the crime, it is indeed suspicious that they were previously almost ousted by Wagner.

programme.title: Welcome To Norway!
programme.desc: A witty dramedy about a racist and broke hotel owner, Primus, who starts a refugee asylum centre at his mountain resort. He meets Abedi, an annoying optimist who takes him on one hell of a ride but ultimately, changes his life and touches his heart.

programme.desc: Bruno, a stay-at-home father of two, gets back in touch with his masculinity when his wife is kidnapped in Marseille. Instead of the planned holiday on the Côte d'Azur, Bruno gets deeper and deeper into an intrigue, pursued by police and mafia.

programme.title: Wonderfully Beautiful
programme.desc: Ranging from a 60-year-old retiree who no longer finds herself desirable to a daughter trying to make her breakthrough as a model, five women of different ages confront their self-image and the expectation they have for themselves and the people around them.

programme.title: Jeera Goli
programme.desc: The pursuit of a 4-year-old innocent Dev, wanting to play with his grandfather, but isn't allowed to by his parents as unknown to him, his grandfather is in a coma.

programme.desc: Felix enjoys his single life to the fullest, but a ferret bites him, sterilizing him in the process. He tries everything in his power to find the soon-to-be mother of his only child, the result of his first and last sperm donation.

programme.title: Asia S01 - The Arid Heart

On the arid grasslands, Pallas Cats need ingenious ways to get close to their prey, Mongolian Gazelles must battle harsh winters and human barriers, and Takhi are terrorised each night by Mongolian wolves.

programme.title: Planet Earth S01 - Freshwater

Planet Earth captures unique and dramatic moments of animal behaviour: a showdown between smooth-coated otters and mugger crocodiles, deep-diving long tailed macaques, massive flocks of snow geese on the wing and a piranha frenzy in the perilous waters of the world

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Dream Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Rainbow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are out walking around in the rain with Duggee and notice a rainbow! But before they know it, it's gone and the Squirrels are devastated. Duggee shows the Squirrels what he has been working on too - a rainbow cake!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Ambition Badge
programme.desc: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks. This encourages the Squirrels to think of their own ambitions, and how they can achieve them.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Aqueduct of Segovia
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch has turned the Segovia Aqueduct into a giant water slide, by removing some of it's ancient stones to make it slope. The Go Jetters don't have long to stop Glitch and re-build the historic structure - Go Jetters, Go!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Stokkur Geyser, Iceland

So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Transport Badge

programme.desc: Stanley and the children tour the museum and quickly realise there's nothing about them or their friends, so they make a new exhibit all about their town today!

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Always Wanted to be a Crab
programme.desc: The talking animals talk about all the things they love about the ocean.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S03 - It's Time for a Harvest Festival
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran join Julie at the farm for the harvest festival. Julie gives JoJo, Gran Gran and their friends a special tractor ride to the harvesting field, where there's lots for everyone to do. JoJo loves helping out with Alfie, Isaiah and Henry. But what can they do with all the fruit - it's time for a Gran Gran plan?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cricket
programme.desc: During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ghostbasket - Bluey special trilogy episode 1
programme.desc: Dad is pretending to be an estate agent selling the Grannies' house to Mum, but Janet and Rita do not want to move out. They try to disrupt the sale by ambushing Mum in the hallway, driving their car through the kitchen and introducing Ghostbasket - a ghastly haunted washing basket.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Surprise! - Bluey special trilogy episode 3
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want dad to play two different games, so dad tries to play both at the same time. While also watching the race on TV.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Splash Dash
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Hailstorm
programme.desc: The Go Jetters join Ubercorn in the Go Jet Academy to try out a brand new click-on: the G.O. Vac, a super vacuum that can suck up bad weather. In order to put it to the test, Ubercorn creates a small hailstorm cloud inside the dome and Lars tries to suck it up with the G.O. Vac. However, Glitch appears and tries to show off his new 'Grim-o-Freeze' and zaps the cloud. Instead of disappearing, it grows in size and ferocity, breaking the roof with a smash.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Pepper
programme.desc: Pepper performs a bell ringing act.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Peas
programme.desc: Two peas perform a happy song.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Merry Sprouty Day Part 2
programme.desc: It's Merry Sprouty Day, but Evil Pea jumps onto Sprouty Claus's train and steals all the presents for herself!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Robotato
programme.desc: Evil Pea has trapped Supertato and replaced him with an evil robot lookalike called Robotato.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Spinning
programme.desc: The Teletubbies travel by Tubby Car to the Hidey Hup where they all spin around on the Tubby Spinny.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - Ball
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ball and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different balls and explore how they look and what they do. There's a green ball, a blue ball and even a ball that goes moo! There's a seat ball, some meatballs and a funny ball too! We see a ball to kick, a ball for disco dancing and a sparkly ball on a Christmas tree! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S02 - Messy Migration
programme.desc: When a little turtle gets stranded on the beach in OKIDO, Messy helps her rejoin her friends so they can begin their journey across the ocean.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Ludwig The Lady
programme.desc: Jackson's big, blue chicken-thing, Ludwig, is going to lay an egg. And it's up to Mojo and Bo to carry the big bird across dangerous roads to Preston's egg-hatching shed!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Good Choices
programme.desc: The Squirrels haven't been making good choices round the messy clubhouse. With Duggee's help, they start to get it right. But not before sending Roly's imagination into overdrive!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Waiting Badge
programme.desc: When they're accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Frog Song
programme.desc: It's fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a ribbit song, and Enid turns into anime to chase after a mouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Hey Quacky!
programme.desc: Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Gliding, Argentina
programme.desc: The Go Jet cadets are taking to the skies in Argentina in an attempt to pass their academy gliding test. As gliders do not have engines, Xuli is teaching two other pilot cadets how to glide using thermals to keep them up in the air. Not wanting to miss out on the aerial action, Grandmaster Glitch gatecrashes the flying lesson in his Grim Glider! Not only has his glider got an engine, but he also wants to make the lesson into a race. Not cool...

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Hide and Seek
programme.desc: It's time for a family game of hide and seek. Everyone hides, while Bluey counts to twenty, but will she be able to stay focused on the game and not get distracted by all her toys.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Road Trip
programme.desc: Mum helps Bluey and Bingo find ways to entertain themselves on a family road trip, while Dad tries to stay ahead of the grey nomad convoy or risk camping near the toilets.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pavlova
programme.desc: Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Rain
programme.desc: When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Dino Poop
programme.desc: Jen is studying the poop of different dinosaurs on the island, so Andy heads out on an epic adventure to collect some samples. Along the way, he meets an Alamosaurus.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Bubbles
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun blowing and popping bubbles. In the Cloud Kitchen, all the bubbles give Patch an idea for a tasty treat - blast off melon rockets!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Eating Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having a picnic and notice that the chickens eat differently than they do. Duggee has his eating badge and can explain all the different ways animals eat. Some animals eat slowly like cows, who eat all day long. But others eat quickly like frogs. Some, like goats, are always eating, while tortoises can go a whole year without food. Some animals eat food that is very high up, like giraffes, and some eat food that is very low down, like moles. The Squirrels finish off their picni

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Dream Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are at the Clubhouse playing, but they can't stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Luckily, Duggee has his dream badge and can help the Squirrels work out what they mean. As the Squirrels think about dreams, all the different dreams of the Clubhouse friends become weirder and more wonderful. We even get to see Duggee's dream!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Rainbow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are out walking around in the rain with Duggee and notice a rainbow! But before they know it, it's gone and the Squirrels are devastated. They decide to make their own rainbow and go off in search of all the colours from everything around them, including strawberries, carrots and bananas. Duggee shows the Squirrels what he has been working on too - a rainbow cake!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch wants to watch his favourite DVD in peace, so uses his remote control to pause the Rio Carnival in Brazil!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Aqueduct of Segovia
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch has turned the Segovia Aqueduct into a giant water slide, by removing some of it's ancient stones to make it slope. But taking some of the perfectly balanced stones away means that the tall columns of the aqueduct are wobbling, and could come crashing down! The Go Jetters don't have long to stop Glitch and re-build the historic structure - Go Jetters, Go!

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Steam Team to the Rescue
programme.desc: Thomas and the steam trains spring into action when Porter and the diesel engines run into a series of accidents that throw their deliveries off track.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponent's son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chan's elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: Yun Fei Yang, a Wudang servant hiding his identity as the sect leader's illegitimate son, is framed by long-hidden enemies and branded a traitor after losing his father. Hunted by rival forces and stripped of his martial arts, he masters the legendary “Tian Chan Gong” and rises again to clear his name and settle a generations-old blood feud.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller; playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the "yin and yang combination" to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily finds help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tian's rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tian's granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: In this surprisingly light-hearted "Venoms" martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequently, the spirit of the Yu Ji rises from his dead body and takes revenge on Sun Che.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy “House of 72 tenants”, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Lady is the Boss
programme.desc: Mei, a young overseas Chinese woman, returns to Hong Kong to take over a traditional martial arts school. Her modern management style clashes with her conservative senior disciple, sparking disputes and attracting local gangsters. Forced to put aside their differences, they join forces to fight back and defend the school's honour.

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend “Investiture of the Gods”, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperor's Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him-only for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Qin Ai De Hai Zi Men - EP1
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Qin Ai De Hai Zi Men - EP2
